description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeSkillDao class, which manages database operations related to employee skills in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for saving, retrieving, deleting, and searching employee skill data, utilizing Doctrine ORM for database interactions.
external_methods: Doctrine ORM Query Builder methods: createQueryBuilder, leftJoin, andWhere, setParameter, getQuery, execute
OrangeHRM Core BaseDao methods: persist, getRepository, getPaginator, setSortingAndPaginationParams
